author: Unity
description:
Unity Graph Toolkit provides a graph-based framework for creating your own node-based tools to use in the Unity Editor. Create tools that enable non-technical teammates to build game systems without having to access code. 

This video starts with steps for how to get started with Graph Toolkit. It then uses two sample projects for Graph Toolkit; you’ll see how to expand a visual novel sample with new video and audio nodes, as well as a branching dialogue option. Find the other two-option node sample below.

More Resources
